findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced last week." is followed by a `<ul>` containing only three `<li>` entries (Holiday Campaign Assets, Support Backlog Triage, Mobile App Revamp)
findings.fix: Either add the fourth project (e.g. "Q3 Roadmap," which appears later in project-settings) to the list, or correct the copy to say "3 projects."
findings.location: workspace-overview section, "Your projects" intro paragraph and the project list
findings.violation: The stated project count (4) does not match the number of projects actually listed (3), leaving it unclear whether a project is missing or the count is wrong.

findings.evidence: Links such as `href="#invite-member"`, `href="#archive-confirm"`, `href="#invite-sent"` target sibling `<section>` elements, but the document has no CSS (e.g. `:target` rules) or script to hide non-active sections.
findings.fix: Add CSS such as `section:not(:target){display:none}` (with the initial screen shown by default) or equivalent JS show/hide logic so only one section is visible at a time.
findings.location: overall document structure (no `<style>` or `<script>` anywhere, applies to all `<section>` elements linked via `href="#..."`)
findings.violation: The anchors imply a step-by-step "screen" flow (Save → Continue → confirmation, Cancel/Archive, etc.), but with nothing to hide inactive sections, every section renders simultaneously on one long page, defeating the intended wizard-style navigation.

findings.evidence: `<input id="project-settings-name-input" type="text" value="Q3 Roadmap">`, `<input id="invite-member-email-input" type="email">`, and `<select id="notification-settings-digest-input">` - none carry a `name` attribute.
findings.location: project-settings, invite-member, and notification-settings form controls
findings.violation: Without `name` attributes, none of the form controls would submit identifiable data even if the forms were properly wired to a backend.

findings.evidence: `<form>` ... `<button id="project-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button>` - none of the three `<form>` tags specify an `action` or `method` attribute.
findings.fix: Add real `action`/`method` attributes, or add a submit handler (e.g. `onsubmit="return false"`) if this is intended to remain a client-only mockup.
findings.violation: Clicking any "Save" button will trigger a real form submission (GET to the current URL) since nothing intercepts it, reloading the page and discarding the current fragment/screen state instead of performing an inline save.

findings.fix: Add visible label text (e.g. "Duplicate") or an icon plus visually-hidden text alongside the `aria-label`.
findings.violation: The button has no visible text or icon content, only an `aria-label`, so sighted users see a blank, unlabeled button with no indication of its purpose.
